title: A defaults accessor turned into a shared mutable singleton, outside the claim
claim: withOverrides in src/defaults.mjs now concatenates the default tags with the user's tags instead of overwriting them, so setting one option no longer discards the default tags. test/defaults.test.mjs covers the merge and passes.
changeCommitMessage: fix(defaults): preserve default tags when merging overrides

defect.summary: defaultOptions, changed by the same commit but absent from the claim, now returns a module-level DEFAULTS object instead of a fresh literal, so any caller that mutates the result corrupts the defaults for every later call.
